modelRequired: PSTATE pins cover catcher/longjmp_err, conversion temps, fp/R0 restore, W_ALL/R_ALL and CFUN_OOL caller status reads; local close cannot set total borrow count to zero while outer receiver/caller/nested activation remains; source cleanup permit needs all source pins zero plus observed VM acceptance and physical unlink/root-view evidence; activation identity is not processor or reused stack address

Conversion release helpers, AT_END text, release_foreign and procedural interrupt execute_fn are separate effect producers; register child cleanup duty before callback exposure or parent discharge; invoke only admitted origin/thread/effect profile, transfer root/native/code custody before dropping source pin, and keep child data debt after VM-independent transfer; deferral of unstarted child into a successor epoch additionally needs no current write authority or queued native invocation, closed admission and future reentry gate, preserving task/root/native debt; unknown acceptance or callback longjmp retains duty, cannot guess completion or refund

Saved catcher identity and native frame/thread incarnation are pinned before installing local guard; restoring the exact predecessor is a write under source borrow before dropping that guard; generated state used after jump lives in protected off-stack storage, not changed nonvolatile automatic locals; borrowed jmp_buf remains a live same-thread target and is never handed to GC/helper worker for longjmp; builtin/library/dynamic-import profiles require separate C/backend qualification

Original-to-receiver and parent-to-callback ticket publication precedes source release with one canonical authority; coordinator acquire sees all closures and zero outstanding effects; cleanup acquires accepted VM view and exact zero source-pin census under admission exclusion; native C emitter preserves standard setjmp call context, lifetime and local-value rules or qualified builtin profile, and atomic/lock implementation, layout and compiler code-motion remain unproved

propagate_error NO_ERR returns but still reads native context, nonzero calls throw_error and THROW writes longjmp_err then jumps; reserve propagation receiver and root/code/PSTATE duty before original close/drop; matching ___call restores frame after local catcher restoration, nonmatching rethrows to outer target; trampoline-only trips keep original guard alive; ordinary CFUN conversion errors return/jump to handler before propagate_error, UNWIND_C_STACK can reach it; no arbitrary replay of throw

Replace managed generated END/cleanup exits and raw marker retirement with one off-stack exit service and exactly-once disposition, route shrink/rollback/shutdown/exported cleanup through permit; cleanup callback registration competes with final admission cut atomically; callback added after cut must refuse or enter a separately counted successor cohort before domain freeze, never reopen old seal; failed/unknown native join retains thread/TLS/code envelope independently of data closure

Future task and parked current invocation retain GC-visible roots, immutable input snapshots or qualified borrowed storage, native payload/code/catcher leases and exact result identity; VM transfer is not disposal, nonzero processor roots require all-domain scanner integration, native deletion/refcount decrement cannot reclaim before old invocation borrowers drain; unknown native or claim outcome retains custody and cannot authorize replay/refund

Already claimed/native-issued/running invocation is not an unstarted future task; unissued owned claim may cancel only under same atomic arbitration as native issue/start, lost claim response remains canonical duty; running invocation either completes or participates in GC with a qualified parked-current root/continuation/PSTATE view and revoked current write permit; parked native activation retains catcher/code/resource identity and resumes in place, never replayed as new callback

One owned async task, publication ticket, queue/claim/native-issue/running/parked/future/completed states and two epochs; queued and running profiles; early native gate, complete adapters, atomic claim/cancel, participating parked root view and whole-round preparation are premises; no full collector, arbitrary recursion, C source/ABI/weak-memory or liveness proof

24 conditional declarations: gate closure does not drain existing work, deferred-task exclusions, epoch/context/root/binding authorization and custody Step/Trace, parked resume keeps invocation count; not every QNT action or C source simulation

No existing future-epoch execution-gate issuer; introduce VM-owned AdmissionDomain keyed by VM/domain/epoch/incarnation, with early native ingress covering every callback origin before data_rc, marker allocation, PSTATE reads or closure-self mutation; stop current publication admission, reconcile publication postludes and all claim reservations, then sign FutureEpochGate for retained unstarted async tasks only after canonical VM root/resource/code custody and manifest/exclusion evidence

Close/claim/cancel/native-issue publish under one canonical atomic/exclusion protocol; release certificate follows last current writer and publisher postlude, acquire certifier sees roots and parked views; next epoch release follows capacity/context/binding/root reload and acquire claimant joins matching epoch; all raw callbacks use compatible lifetime-protected ingress before first managed effect; counter generation alone cannot revoke issued stores or cached function pointers, actual C atomic layout and native ABI remain open

Owned procedural interrupt queue needs one ordered dequeue-to-claim and close-to-detach cut under compatible exclusion; register claim before removing head/unlocking, count publisher from header initialization through queue insertion and post-unlock raise_interrupt_pstate; queued task may move to VM future queue with exact execution/release operation semantics, borrowed argument snapshot and custody; preserve accepted enqueue order and per-origin result causality, including canceled claim position unless reordering separately admitted; empty old queue or interrupt masking is not zero in-flight work

After full strong/weak/cleanup/capacity result and selected context preparation, bind exact live owner/VM context, reload relocated root handles, then publish next epoch authority; GC interrupt notification alone precedes prepare_mem_pstate and is not WholeRoundResumeSeal; claimFuture atomically joins next epoch before marker allocation and Scheme entry, parked resume obtains fresh write authority for same native activation; stale old epoch/context/root/owner rejects without guessed rebind

Defer only an origin whose request/result contract permits retained asynchronous task and whose pre-entry transport has no unknown issued invocation; direct synchronous Tcl scheme_call_cmd needs immediate char-string result and borrowed argv, so deferring inside it or returning invented success/pending is not equivalent; gate upstream initiation, qualify participating wait on original invocation, or refuse future-task admission; no synchronous GC wait for a callback whose entry waits for that same GC
